purpose: Part 2/2 of verified hard-tail 17-record item effect batch 016; together these files contain exactly 17 self-contained reviewed records.

items/figurines-of-illusory-escort.name: Figurines of Illusory Escort
items/figurines-of-illusory-escort.effectSummary: On command, each figurine creates for 8 hours a major image of a specified humanoid or monstrous humanoid race, gender, and role as either slave or guard, remaining within 30 feet of the figurine. Slave figures can march, work, or mine and guards can march or stand guard; their movement is varied to seem individual, but they follow their programmed behavior regardless of events. Afterward a figurine cannot be used again for 1 day.

items/gauntlets-blood-lord-621.name: Gauntlets of the Blood-Lord [Relic]
items/gauntlets-blood-lord-621.effectSummary: For a lawful-evil, lawful-neutral, or neutral-evil wearer, the gauntlets function as +1 spiked gauntlets. With the relic connection to Hextor they grant +2 luck on melee touch attacks; with the stronger qualifying connection, every 3rd-level-or-lower melee touch spell cast by the wearer is automatically empowered without a higher spell slot or increased casting time.

items/gauntlets-of-the-talon-603.name: Gauntlets of the Talon [Relic]
items/gauntlets-of-the-talon-603.effectSummary: For a lawful-good, lawful-neutral, or neutral-good wearer, the gauntlets grant two primary magical claw attacks dealing 1d6 slashing damage for a Medium creature. With the relic connection to Bahamut, a monk is treated as five levels higher for AC, unarmed damage, and ki strike and can choose bludgeoning or slashing unarmed damage; with the stronger qualification the claws also gain ghost touch against incorporeal creatures and the wearer gains +4 on grapple checks.

items/gem-of-brightness.name: Gem of Brightness
items/gem-of-brightness.effectSummary: The gem has 50 charges and three command-word modes: a 10-foot cone of pale light costs no charges; a 50-foot ranged-touch ray costs 1 charge and blinds a struck creature for 1d4 rounds unless Reflex DC 14; and a 30-foot cone flash costs 5 charges, blinding creatures for 1d4 rounds on a failed Reflex DC 14 and then imposing -1 on attacks, Spot, and Search from permanent eye damage until cured. It becomes nonmagical when all charges are spent.

items/ghoul-light-lantern.name: Ghoul-Light Lantern
items/ghoul-light-lantern.effectSummary: On command as a move action, the lantern creates bright ghoul-light in a 20-foot radius and shadowy illumination to 40 feet. Living creatures within 20 feet take -1 on Will saves and Charisma checks, undead gain +1 profane on those checks, the light counts as bright illumination for light-sensitive creatures, and exposed creatures glow as if under faerie fire for purposes such as defeating invisibility and displacement.

items/grasping-hook.name: Grasping Hook
items/grasping-hook.effectSummary: A command word animates the mithral hook so it seeks the nearest secure object; speaking it again releases the hook. When thrown attached to silk rope, activating it as a free action grants +6 competence on the Use Rope check to seat it properly. The hook has Strength 25 and can hold 1,600 pounds while securely grasped.

items/helm-purple-plume-618.name: Helm of the Purple Plume [Relic]
items/helm-purple-plume-618.effectSummary: A lawful-good, neutral-good, or lawful-neutral wearer gains +2 enhancement to Charisma. With the relic connection to Heironeous, the wearer also gains +5 morale on saves against fear; whenever the wearer successfully saves against enemy fear, or is immune and is subjected to such fear, the wearer gains heroism for 10 rounds.

items/libram-of-flesh.name: Libram of Flesh
items/libram-of-flesh.effectSummary: The libram lets an arcane spellcaster create flesh golems as though two caster levels higher and emulate the required spell knowledge, though the effective caster level must still reach the normal 14th-level minimum. Flesh golems created with it retain up to five DM-approved abilities from one donor body. A newly created libram has enough magic for seven golems, after which its inscriptions fade and it becomes ruined.
